title: What does the H+ symbol mean on your Samsung phone?

claims.claim: H+ sembolü, Samsung telefonlarda HSPA+ ağ bağlantısına işaret eder.

evidence.quote: This symbol indicates that you are connected to the HSPA+ network.

claims.claim: HSPA, 21 Mbps'ye kadar veri hızı sağlayan bir ağ teknolojisidir.

evidence.quote: HSPA stands for High-Speed Packet Access, and it refers to a network technology that provides data speeds up to 21 Mbps.

claims.claim: HSPA+ ağı kullanıldığında deneyimlenen gerçek hızlar 3.5 ile 14 Mbps arasındadır.

evidence.quote: The actual speeds you will likely experience when connected to these mobile networks is anywhere from 3.5 up to 14 Mbps.

claims.claim: Kırsal bölgelerde HSPA+ hızları 1.5 Mbps'ye kadar düşebilir.

evidence.quote: Some rural areas, depending on where you are, may experience even slower speeds down to 1.5 Mbps.
This is compared to LTE (Long-Term Evolution) speeds that are from 12 to 40 Mbps

claims.claim: LTE Advanced hızları 25 ile 220 Mbps arasındadır.

evidence.quote: and LTE Advanced, which is from 25 up to a blazing fast 220 Mbps.
This is compared to LTE (Long-Term Evolution) speeds that are from 12 to 40 Mbps and LTE Advanced, which is from 25 up to a blazing fast 220 Mbps.

claims.claim: S4 modelinden bu yana neredeyse tüm Samsung Galaxy telefonlar VoLTE'yi desteklemektedir.

evidence.quote: Pretty much every Samsung Galaxy phone since the S4 supports VoLTE, however.

claims.claim: Kanada'daki Bell Mobility, 3G ve HSPA ağını 1 Mart 2027'ye kadar tamamen sonlandırma planlarını duyurmuştur.

evidence.quote: Carriers like Bell Mobility in Canada have announced plans to for a complete phase-out of the 3G/HSPA network across the country by March 1, 2027.
